workarounds.note: proof() reads the source and the set lines itself where the engine has reports of its own (doc.contentWarnings for unknown ids and directives, findLooseLines for loose lines), so that every fault has one shape: a kind, a source range and a detail; lists numbered from a year, formulas and hyphens inside addresses are checks only this story needs

bodyText.maxRuntTracking: 0 keeps runt fixes to word spacing: with tracking, the fares paragraph of the first pass sets a line shorter, and its loose line and the hyphen in the address, two of the faults the desk shows, never appear

the lede is copy-fitted so the fact box's first fragment fills page 1 to its last line: with a line to spare, column balancing moves a box that closes a page down to the foot (headings.balancing.closingBox 'first', the default), leaving a gap between the fares paragraph and the box's stripe
linesOf() runs each justified line's wash and click target to the right edge of its block: line.bbox keeps the line's natural width, not the width it is painted at
